summary: Iteration 101: Tested two new features - (1) /como-ser-verificado page and (2) Strava consent screen. The /como-ser-verificado page passed all 8 tests with correct title, 6 benefit cards, 'Como funciona?' section, CTA button, and no console errors. The Strava consent screen testing was blocked by a mandatory 'Dono de Assessoria' modal that requires creating an assessoria before accessing the profile page. Code review confirms all Strava consent elements are correctly implemented with proper data-testid attributes.

integration_issues.flow: Profile page access for 'Dono de Assessoria' users
integration_issues.issue: Mandatory 'Criar Assessoria' modal blocks access to profile page content including Strava integration. The cidade dropdown in the modal is difficult to interact with programmatically.
integration_issues.note: This is expected behavior for new 'Dono de Assessoria' users who haven't created their assessoria yet

context_for_next_testing_agent: The /como-ser-verificado page is fully functional and tested. The Strava consent screen code is correctly implemented but UI testing was blocked by the 'Dono de Assessoria' modal for the test user. To test Strava consent screen, either: (1) use a different user without 'dono_assessoria' role, (2) complete the assessoria creation for the test user, or (3) manually verify the consent screen by logging in and navigating to /perfil.
